newsitem.title: FRANCE: AOL starts on-line advertising in France.
newsitem.headline: AOL starts on-line advertising in France.

text.p: AOL, the online information joint venture of America Online and Germany's Bertelsmann , said it was starting online advertising in France.
The company added in a statement it had asked Regie On Line, a unit of Lagardere, to manage the advertising on its 60,000 screens in France.
The statement added that companies like IBM, Microsoft, Canon and Perrier were already planning to advertise on AOL France.
